metadata.question: On June 24, 2025, was New York City highest temperature higher than June 24, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need temperature data for NYC on two specific dates: June 24, 2024 and June 24, 2025 - June 24, 2025 is in the future (current date is earlier than this), so no data will exist - Should use ERA5 or MODIS LST (Land Surface Temperature) for temperature data - NYC location: approximately 40.7128°N, 74.0060°W 2. Masking strategy: - Temperature data doesn't need cloud masking typically (ERA5 is modeled, MODIS LST has QA) - Focus on extracting maximum temperature values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If 2025 data doesn't exist (future date), this is C1 (Empty Collection) - If data exists but calculation fails, it's C3 - Compare temperatures if both exist: higher in 2025 = A, not higher = B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nyc = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.0060, 40.7128]); const date2024 = '2024-06-24'; const date2025 = '2025-06-24'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Using ERA5-Land hourly data for temperature (more reliable than MODIS for specific dates) const col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(date2024, '2024-06-25') .filterBounds(nyc) .select('temperature_2m'); const col2025 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(date2025, '2025-06-25') .filterBounds(nyc) .select('temperature_2m'); const size2024 = await col2024.size().getInfo(); const size2025 = await col2025.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2024 Images: ${size2024}`); console.log(`2025 Images: ${size2025}`); // Check if 2025 data exists (it shouldn't - future date) if (size2025 === 0) { console.log('No data available for June 24, 2025 (future date).'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Check if 2024 data exists if (size2024 === 0) { console.log('No data available for June 24, 2024.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get maximum temperature for each day const max2024 = col2024.max(); const max2025 = col2025.max(); // 4. Calculation const temp2024 = await max2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nyc, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); const temp2025 = await max2025.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nyc, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius const temp2024C = temp2024 ? temp2024 - 273.15 : null; const temp2025C = temp2025 ? temp2025 - 273.15 : null; // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (temp2024C === null || temp2025C === null) { console.log('Temperature calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`2024 Max Temp: ${temp2024C.toFixed(2)}C`); console.log(`2025 Max Temp: ${temp2025C.toFixed(2)}C`); if (temp2025C > temp2024C) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
